reason: I already bring my stock through the Erbil company and they have mostly delivered fine, so I have no reason to move my shop's orders to a new name. And for most of what I sell I can walk into the Baghdad market today and have it on the shelf tonight, not in three weeks.
objection: My business depends on goods arriving on time. A new service I have never used, even with Abu Ali's name on it, could hold up my stock, and my current company already works for me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the trader account actually come in cheaper per kilo than my Erbil company on a real batch, with photos from the warehouse and arriving on time, maybe tried once with the free cash-on-delivery first order.
